_comment: A loadout that uses the spells declared by the manifests in this pack. Manifests are reloaded before loadouts on /reload, so validation sees the new declarations immediately. If the add-on is not installed, these spell entries are dropped with an INFO line and the rest of the file still loads.

spells._comment: A known-good vanilla-side spell as a fallback, so the mob is not left with nothing if the add-on is missing.
